description:
Marketing Campaigns Events Copywriting Digital Marketing Marketing Operations

Some marketing roles are all about ideas. Others are all about organisation.

This one brings the two together.

Welcome to Tollring, an award-winning UK technology business helping organisations turn business communications into powerful insights through intelligent analytics, AI-powered solutions and innovative software.

We're growing, investing in exciting new products and expanding our marketing activity. Now we're looking for a bright, proactive Marketing Coordinator to help bring our campaigns, events and communications to life.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone with a couple of years' marketing experience who loves variety, takes pride in the details and wants to develop into a well-rounded marketing professional.

The Role at a Glance

Marketing Coordinator
Uxbridge, West London Hybrid (Typically 1 day per week in the office -Thursdays- with flexibility for additional attendance when required)
£31,000 £36,000 DOE
Full Time Permanent 37.5 hours per week
Monday Friday, 9am 5:30pm

Your Background / Skills: Marketing Coordination, Campaign Support, Event Management, Copywriting, Email Marketing, Digital Marketing, CMS, WordPress, Marketing Administration, Budget Tracking, Excel, Reporting.

The Tollring Story

At Tollring, we're passionate about helping businesses make smarter decisions through technology.

Our award-winning software helps organisations understand customer conversations, improve performance and unlock valuable insights from their communications.

With innovative solutions spanning call analytics, conversation intelligence, call recording and fraud protection, we're a growing technology business with ambitious plans and exciting new product launches ahead.

But what makes Tollring special is our people.

We're a collaborative team where ideas are welcomed, colleagues support one another and everyone has the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution.

Your Role in the Story

Working closely with our Marketing Communications Manager, Digital Marketer and Graphic Designer, you'll help keep a busy, varied marketing function running brilliantly.

One day you might be coordinating an industry event, the next preparing an email campaign, updating website content or pulling together performance reports for senior leadership.

You'll have plenty of guidance and support, but also the freedom to take ownership, solve problems and make things happen.

Where You'll Make an Impact
- Campaigns & Content: Support marketing campaigns, write engaging first drafts for emails and landing pages, and help deliver social and digital marketing activity.
- Website & Digital: Upload and edit website content using CMS platforms, supporting SEO and maintaining brand standards.
- Events & Webinars: Coordinate industry events, exhibitions and webinars, managing suppliers, logistics, materials, deadlines and follow-up reporting.
- Marketing Performance: Compile monthly marketing reports, track campaign activity and help turn results into useful insights.
- Budgets & Administration: Manage marketing spend records, invoices and budget tracking, working closely with the accounts team.
- Internal Communications: Help produce newsletters, coordinate internal events and keep colleagues informed and engaged.
- Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with Sales, Customer Success and senior leadership to support marketing initiatives and partner activities.
- Keeping Things Moving: Stay on top of priorities, anticipate challenges and make sure the little details never become big problems.

About You

You're a marketer at heart, but you're also someone who loves getting things organised and seeing a project through.

You enjoy writing, communicating and contributing creative ideas, while understanding that great marketing also depends on deadlines, budgets, accurate reporting and reliable execution.

You're confident working independently, happy to ask questions and willing to get stuck into whatever needs doing.

You'll bring:
- Around 2 years' experience in a marketing coordination, marketing executive or similar role, ideally within a busy, varied environment.
- Practical experience coordinating events, campaigns or marketing projects with competing deadlines.
- Strong written English, with the ability to draft clear, engaging marketing copy and proofread accurately.
- Excellent organisation, attention to detail and the ability to take ownership of responsibilities.
- Confident everyday IT skills, particularly Microsoft Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel.
- Experience liaising with suppliers, coordinating marketing materials or managing event logistics.
- A basic understanding of marketing principles and how campaigns engage different audiences.
- A proactive, adaptable approach and the confidence to work across different teams and priorities.

Even better if you have:
- Experience in B2 B technology, SaaS, software or telecoms.
- Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, Zoho CRM, Buffer or Mailchimp.
- Experience tracking marketing budgets, campaign performance or event-generated leads.
- Experience updating website content using a CMS.
- An interest in using AI and emerging tools to improve marketing effectiveness.

You don't need to be an expert in every marketing discipline. What matters is that you've already developed a solid professional foundation, can manage your own workload and are genuinely excited to keep learning.

Why Join Tollring?

Because this isn't a role where you'll spend your career doing the same thing every day.

You'll gain exposure to campaigns, events, digital marketing, content, reporting and the commercial side of marketing, all while working alongside experienced colleagues who are happy to share their knowledge.

As Tollring continues to grow, there's real scope to develop your skills, take on more campaign responsibility and shape your future in marketing.

You'll also enjoy:
- A salary of £31,000 £36,000 DOE.
- Hybrid working with a supportive, collaborative team.
- Exposure to exciting technology, product launches and B2 B marketing.
- A varied role with genuine ownership and visibility across the business.
- Opportunities for training, learning and professional development.
- The chance to make a real impact within a growing, established technology company.

Ready to Make Things Happen?

If you're an organised, enthusiastic marketer who enjoys variety, loves getting the details right and wants to build a brilliant career in B2 B marketing, we'd love to hear from you.

Advocate Group are excited to be partnering exclusively with Tropicana Brands Group to recruit a Marketing Manager for Naked, one of the most recognised brands in the smoothie category.

And this is much more than simply managing an established brand.

Naked is entering an exciting next phase, with significant investment, strong senior backing and real ambition around where the brand can go next.

There is significant investment behind the brand and a genuine appetite from the leadership team to push it further.

That creates a great combination. You have the scale, resources and reach of Tropicana Brands Group, alongside the opportunity to think entrepreneurially and make a very visible impact on the future of Naked.

A genuinely hands-on Marketing Manager role

You will have a Brand Manager reporting into you, but this is a lean, entrepreneurial marketing team.

You will need to be equally comfortable setting the direction, influencing senior stakeholders and agency partners, and getting into the detail yourself to make things happen.

This is not a role for someone who simply wants to maintain what is already there.

We are looking for someone who wants to build.

Who are we looking for?

We are deliberately keeping the background broad.

You could currently be working in food, drinks, beauty, personal care, health, wellness, alcohol or another strong consumer-led category. What matters more is the type of marketer you are.

You will ideally bring:
- Strong brand-building experience within a consumer environment

What matters is that you are a brand builder, not simply a brand custodian.

Someone who wants to understand what is driving performance, identify where the next growth opportunity sits, create brilliant work and stay close enough to the business to see that work translate into results.

Why Naked?

You will be joining at a point where the ingredients are already there: a hugely recognised brand, investment, leadership support, an established consumer platform and significant headroom for growth.

Now comes the opportunity to help shape what Naked becomes next.

For the right marketer, this has all the ingredients to become one of those roles you can look back on as a defining piece of work in your career.

You're organised, creative, commercially aware and confident managing multiple moving parts without losing sight of the details.

- Hands-on experience managing creator campaigns from brief to delivery

- Confidence managing client communications and expectations
- Excellent organisation and the ability to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines

Founded in 2020, TSA has quickly established itself as an exciting name in creator-led social media marketing.

- Work from anywhere allowance

title: Senior Manager - CRM & Relationship Intelligence
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Manager - CRM & Relationship Intelligence to join our Marketing team. This opportunity is open to A&O Shearman's London or Belfast office.
Marketing team
Our Marketing team helps the firm win and grow the right clients and work. We drive client development across the firm, deepening priority relationships, increasing share of wallet and converting strategic opportunities into profitable revenue. We equip partners with effective go-to-market strategies, tactics and processes, differentiated insights and disciplined execution. Alongside this, we strengthen the firm's market profile and reputation to support client acquisition, retention, and growth. We work as one integrated global team, aligning central support and expertise with local knowledge and execution to maximize impact across offices, practice groups, sectors and client programs.
The marketing Technology team is responsible for the strategy, implementation, governance, and ongoing management of the firm's marketing, business development, and client relationship technology ecosystem. The team delivers and supports the platforms, data, integrations, and digital capabilities that underpin client development, relationship intelligence, marketing operations, and business growth.
The team manages a broad portfolio of technologies, including CRM and relationship intelligence platforms, marketing automation tools, digital marketing channels, data and analytics solutions, client and public websites, content management systems, social media publishing tools, and related marketing applications. The firm has invested heavily in our technology, data and AI, including the global implementation of Microsoft Dynamics. Working closely with Marketing, Business Development, Technology, Data, AI and Information Security teams, the function drives adoption, data quality, innovation, and operational excellence across the firm's marketing technology landscape.
What you will do
The Senior Manager, CRM & Relationship Intelligence is responsible for maximising the business value of the firm's CRM and relationship intelligence technologies and capabilities. Reporting to the Global Head of Marketing Data, AI and Technology, the role owns the firm's CRM product roadmap, business requirements, adoption and value realisation, ensuring trusted client and relationship data supports stronger relationships, better relationships intelligence and opportunity identification and more coordinated client development.
The role will lead the evolution of CRM from a system of record towards an intelligent client-development capability, using Microsoft Dynamics 365, relationship intelligence, analytics, automation and AI to turn trusted data into timely, actionable insight.
Working across Marketing, Business Development, Technology, Data, Risk and Information Security, the Senior Manager will ensure that CRM processes, data and technology evolve in line with the wider Marketing Data, AI and Technology strategy and provide a strong foundation for AI-enabled experiences across the Microsoft ecosystem.
We are looking for a talented and personable expert with a strong understanding of CRM marketing tooling, data privacy experience, and a proven track record of delivery. Experience of MS Dynamics and the wider MS tech stack is essential.
CRM Strategy & Platform Ownership
Own the delivery and continuous improvement of the firm's CRM and relationship intelligence roadmap, under the strategic direction of the Global Head of Marketing Data, AI and Technology.
- Contribute to the development and execution of the firm's CRM strategy and roadmap.
- Act as the owner for CRM capabilities, integrations, user experience, and day-to-day platform effectiveness.
- Identify opportunities to leverage CRM data, relationship intelligence, AI, automation, and analytics to enhance client engagement, cross-selling, and commercial effectiveness.
- Lead the prioritization and delivery of enhancements, with technology teams, vendors, business stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management
- Translate business requirements into solutions that support business objectives and user needs.
- Facilitate CRM governance forums, gathering stakeholder feedback and prioritizing enhancement requests.
- Build strong relationships with senior business stakeholders, providing regular updates on platform performance, adoption, key initiatives, and delivery progress.
- Escalate risks, dependencies, and strategic considerations to the Global Head of Marketing, Data, AI and Technology.

AI and technology
Support and promote the effective use of AI, automation, and advanced analytics within the CRM and relationship intelligence ecosystem, identifying opportunities to enhance client insights, improve business development effectiveness, automate manual processes, and increase the value derived from firm relationship data.
- Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and predictive analytics to improve relationship insights, contact management, data quality, pipeline visibility, and cross-selling opportunities.
- Define and track success measures for AI-enabled CRM initiatives, demonstrating improvements in productivity, data quality, user adoption, client insight generation, and business development outcomes.

Data Governance & Quality
- Implement CRM data governance standards and policies in alignment with firm-wide frameworks.
- Lead initiatives to improve CRM data integrity, completeness, consistency, accuracy, and compliance.
- Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Information Security, and Data Privacy teams to ensure appropriate data handling, access controls, and regulatory compliance.
- Monitor data quality KPIs and metrics, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

Platform Administration & Optimization
- Oversee the day-to-day administration of the CRM platform.
- Monitor platform performance and user experience, identifying opportunities to improve functionality, adoption, reliability, and operational effectiveness.
- Work with Technology teams and vendors to support platform upgrades, testing, integrations, issue resolution.
- Lead the delivery of CRM enhancements and projects, from requirements gathering and business case development through implementation, change management, and user adoption.
- Ensure CRM capabilities and processes remain aligned with business requirements.

Reporting & Analytics
- Develop and maintain CRM dashboards, reports, and insight solutions that provide actionable visibility into client relationships, pipeline activity, marketing effectiveness, and business development performance.
- Provide CRM-derived insights and analysis to support business planning, client development initiatives, and decision-making by marketing and business development leaders.
- Collaborate with stakeholders to identify reporting requirements and translate business needs into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
- Drive the adoption of reporting and self-service analytics capabilities, enabling data-driven decisions.
- Monitor reporting effectiveness and data quality, recommending enhancements to improve insight generation.

Team leadership and development
- Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and development opportunities to team members, setting high standards for performance, collaboration, client focus, and delivery excellence.
- Work with project manager, project sponsor and core members of the MS Dynamics project team - leading the day-to-day aspects of the project as the firm's product owner.
- Build team capability in CRM, relationship intelligence, data management, reporting, and business partnering.
- Create opportunities for team members to engage with stakeholders, client development activities, progressively building their confidence, commercial awareness, and leadership capabilities.

Adoption & Change Management
- Lead the planning and delivery of CRM adoption initiatives, embed effective ways of working.
- Develop and deliver training, communications, best practice frameworks and user enablement programmes.
- Monitor user adoption, engagement, and satisfaction, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
- Partner with champions to drive behavioural change and increase the quality of CRM data and processes.
- Gather user feedback and insights to inform enhancements, training priorities, and future adoption activities.

Vendor Management & Platform Partnerships
Manage key CRM vendor relationships to ensure high-quality service delivery, continuous platform improvement, and alignment with business requirements, while providing recommendations to support technology investment.

title: Social Media Management Executive - Creative Agency
description:
Community Management Content Scheduling & Publishing Social Analytics & Reporting Multiple Client Accounts

Love social media? Not just creating content, but everything that goes into making brand accounts thrive?

From planning and publishing posts to engaging communities, analysing performance and keeping multiple client accounts running smoothly, you know there's much more to great social media management than meets the eye.

Perhaps you're already working in a social media agency, managing several brands and ready for greater ownership. Or you're in a multi-brand environment where you've developed strong all-round experience and want to take your next step.

Welcome to TSA (The Stile Agency).

We're a rapidly growing, creator-inspired social media agency working with exciting brands including De'Longhi, E.ON Next, The Collective and Jack Daniel's.

We've grown by over 70% in the last 12 months, combining the energy and creativity of a fast-moving agency with the backing of global independent creative agency Five by Five.

Now we're looking for a talented Social Media Management Executive who can confidently manage the day-to-day social media activity of multiple clients, from community engagement and content publishing through to analytics, reporting and performance improvement.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys the full social media management process, not just one part of it.

The Role at a Glance

Social Media Management Executive

Central London Hybrid - Office Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday

Up to £35,000 DOE

Full Time Permanent

Your Role in the Story

You'll be responsible for keeping multiple client social media accounts running smoothly, ensuring content is planned, scheduled and published accurately, communities are engaged and performance is consistently monitored.

Working closely with our creative and strategy teams, you'll turn social media plans into effective day-to-day activity, maintaining each brand's distinctive voice while ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

You'll also dig into the data, understand what's working and use those insights to recommend improvements.

It's a varied, fast-paced role where organisation, attention to detail and genuine social media expertise make all the difference.

About You

You're a hands-on social media professional who genuinely enjoys the detail behind managing successful brand accounts.

You're comfortable switching between different clients, keeping content calendars organised, engaging online communities and analysing results.

You understand that great social media management requires creativity, consistency, organisation and a clear understanding of performance.

Most importantly, you've done the work yourself. You're not just overseeing social media activity or developing high-level strategies. You're confident getting stuck into the day-to-day delivery.

You'll Bring
- Typically 2-4 years' hands-on social media management experience, ideally within an agency or multi-brand environment.
- Experience managing multiple client or brand social media accounts simultaneously, confidently balancing competing priorities.
- Practical community management experience, including monitoring and responding to comments, messages and online conversations.
- Hands-on content scheduling and publishing experience, managing calendars, captions, assets and posting schedules.
- Experience analysing social media performance and producing reports, with the ability to explain results and recommend improvements.
- Confidence using Sprout Social, Hootsuite or similar social media management platforms.
- A strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube and platform-specific best practices.
- Excellent copywriting, grammar and attention to detail, with the ability to adapt to different brand voices.
- Strong organisation and time management skills, particularly when managing several accounts and deadlines.
- Clear, professional communication skills and confidence working with clients and internal teams.
- A proactive, collaborative attitude and genuine enthusiasm for social media.

Experience with social media audits, Excel and PowerPoint would be valuable, while Google Analytics knowledge would be a bonus.

We're looking for someone who brings the full package: community management, content scheduling and publishing, social analytics, reporting and experience managing multiple accounts.

Why TSA?

Founded in 2020, TSA has quickly established itself as an exciting name in creator-led social media marketing.

We're growing fast, working with brilliant brands and building an agency where creativity, collaboration and fresh thinking are encouraged.

You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of client accounts, work closely with talented creative and strategy teams and develop your skills across the full social media management process.

It's a great next step for someone who's built solid hands-on experience and is ready to make a bigger impact in a growing agency.

What We Offer
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays.
- Bupa private healthcare and health cash plan.
- Pension scheme with increasing employer contributions.
- Work from anywhere benefit.
- Enhanced parental leave, subject to eligibility.
- Life and personal accident insurance.
- Discounted shopping and gym memberships.
- Interest-free commuting and life loans.
- Free fruit and office bar.
- The opportunity to work with exciting brands in a rapidly growing creative agency.

Ready to Make Your Mark?

Join TSA and help bring brilliant social media strategies to life.

Apply now.

- Experience working for a premium or luxury consumer brand, ideally within Food & Beverage, Hospitality, Fashion, Lifestyle, Culture or Ecommerce.

- Hands-on experience with Meta Ads and TikTok Ads.

title: Used Cars Marketing Specialist
description:
Are you passionate about automotive marketing and the used car market? Here's an exciting opportunity to help shape and grow the used car proposition for two ambitious, fast-growing automotive brands!

Job Title: Used Car Marketing Specialist

Location: London

Working Pattern: Fully on-site

Job Type: Permanent, Full-time

Salary: £45,000 per annum

About the Opportunity

Our client is an ambitious and rapidly growing automotive business with an expanding presence in the UK market. As part of its continued growth and development, the business is looking to strengthen its used car proposition across its brands. They are seeking a commercially minded and proactive Used Car Marketing Specialist to develop and deliver effective marketing strategies, support the dealer network and enhance the overall customer journey. This is an exciting opportunity for someone with automotive marketing experience who wants to make a real impact in a growing business.

The Role - Key Responsibilities

Used Car Marketing Strategy & Campaigns
- Develop and deliver the UK used car marketing strategy, ensuring alignment with brand positioning and commercial objectives.
- Create and execute campaigns to increase awareness, consideration and customer confidence in purchasing Approved Used vehicles.
- Support the development and communication of Approved Used propositions, including customer benefits, vehicle standards, warranties and aftersales support.
- Coordinate used car marketing events and campaigns alongside new vehicle launches, dealer sales plans and seasonal opportunities.
- Build relationships with key automotive marketplaces and media partners, including AutoTrader, Carwow and Google, to maximise marketing opportunities.
- Work closely with internal teams and external agencies to develop effective marketing materials for national and dealer-level campaigns.
- Ensure all used car marketing communications are accurate, timely and consistent across customer touchpoints.
- Monitor competitor activity, market trends and customer expectations, sharing relevant insights with the wider team.

Dealer Network Marketing Standards
- Establish and maintain clear marketing standards for the presentation and promotion of used vehicles across the dealer network.
- Develop dealer guidance, marketing toolkits, templates and training materials to ensure consistent execution.
- Conduct regular audits of dealer websites, vehicle stock listings and customer-facing marketing activity.
- Ensure listings meet required standards for photography, vehicle descriptions, specifications, pricing, calls to action and brand presentation.
- Record audit findings, identify recurring issues and agree corrective action plans with dealers and internal stakeholders.
- Monitor progress against agreed actions and escalate persistent or significant issues where necessary.
- Identify and share examples of best practice to improve marketing standards across the dealer network.

Website & Online Listings Management
- Maintain and continuously improve used car content across brand websites, working closely with digital, go-to-market and dealer network teams.
- Review and optimise the customer journey, from initial vehicle search and discovery through to dealer enquiry.
- Ensure vehicle listings are accurate, complete, up to date and consistently presented across all relevant platforms.
- Identify and resolve issues including missing stock, outdated information, poor-quality imagery, broken links and inconsistent dealer details.
- Use website and campaign performance data to recommend improvements to content, navigation and lead generation.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement
- Monitor and report on used car marketing campaigns, dealer standards and digital performance.
- Develop dashboards and regular performance updates covering stock visibility, listing quality, website traffic, customer enquiries, campaign results and dealer audit outcomes.
- Use performance data, dealer feedback and customer insights to identify opportunities for improvement.
- Provide clear, concise recommendations and updates to relevant stakeholders.
- Manage campaign budgets, external suppliers and project deadlines in line with agreed processes.

What We're Looking For - Experience & Skills
- Previous experience in automotive marketing, used vehicle sales or a closely related role is a must.
- Good understanding of the used car market, including different sales channels and remarketing routes.
- Experience working with dealer networks, retailers or multiple local business partners.
- Strong digital marketing knowledge, particularly website content management, online vehicle listing platforms and customer journeys.
- Experience conducting audits against defined standards and confidently following up on corrective actions.
- Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines and priorities simultaneously.
- Excellent reporting, analytical and organisational skills, with the ability to interpret performance data and identify improvements.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, practical and actionable guidance.
- Good working knowledge of marketing performance and reporting tools.

title: Warehouse Manager (Light Warehousing/Ecommerce)
company: Regulation GB Ltd - HQ & Warehouse - Agency - Permanent
description:
REGULATION is a London-based adult lifestyle and fetish retailer for the LGBT+ community, established in 1991. We retail via our Soho retail store, online, and have a small warehouse in Walthamstow, North London.

We are looking for a hands-on Warehouse Manager to run the day-to-day operation of our E17 warehouse, from receiving and returns through to picking, packing and despatch. You will lead a small team of two Warehouse Operatives, report to the Directors, and be accountable for stock accuracy, order turnaround and a safe, tidy working environment. This is a working role: you will pick, pack and receive alongside the team as well as plan, organise and improve how the warehouse runs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Running the warehouse
- Plan and oversee daily goods in, picking, packing, returns and despatch so orders leave on time
- Get hands-on. Pick, pack and process stock alongside the team using PDAs, our warehouse and order systems
- Receive and check deliveries and customer returns, and put new stock and returns into the correct locations
- Manage carrier collections and despatch, and resolve courier issues with our shipping partners
- Keep work areas clean, tidy and well organised, and take responsibility for housekeeping and quality assurance

Stock control
- Maintain accurate stock levels and locations, and track stock movement between the warehouse, workshop and our Soho store
- Carry out regular cycle counts and stock takes, and investigate and correct discrepancies
- Flag low package stocks and reorder needs

Leading the team
- Lead, train and support two Warehouse Operatives, setting clear daily priorities and standards
- Manage rotas, holiday cover and absence in line with company policy, using our HR system
- Carry out inductions, regular one-to-ones and annual appraisals, working with the Directors of Operations & HR
- Be involved with recruitment of new warehouse team members in line with HR procedures

Health, safety and performance
- Implement and enforce health and safety procedures, manual handling practice and risk assessments, and report incidents promptly
- Meet agreed KPIs for order turnaround, pick accuracy, stock accuracy and returns processing
- Work with Directors to improve warehouse efficiency, layout and processes
- Report on performance and flag problems early

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

Essential
- At least 2 years of warehouse or stockroom experience, ideally in e-commerce or retail fulfilment
- Experience of leading or supervising a small team, or a clear readiness to step up into it
- Confident with inventory or warehouse management software and PDAs, and comfortable learning new systems
- Strong attention to detail and accurate record-keeping
- Good literacy and numeracy, and clear communication with colleagues and carriers
- Able to prioritise, problem-solve and work at pace without losing accuracy
- Reliable, organised and a team player with a can-do attitude

Desirable
- Experience with order management systems
- Experience working with couriers such as DPD, FedEx and Royal Mail
- First aid or manual handling qualification, or willingness to train
- Experience of recruiting, inducting and appraising staff

Physical requirements
- Standing or walking for long periods
- Lifting, bending, twisting and moving products up to 15kg
- No forklift or MHE operation is required at our site

Please note: REGULATION sells adult lifestyle and fetish products. You will handle and pack these items daily, so you must be comfortable working with adult content.

Benefits

Staff discount,Free Parking, NEST pension, Cycle to Work scheme, Team socials, Casual dress

title: Marketing Coordinator - Join an Award-Winning Tech Innovator
description:
Marketing Campaigns Events Copywriting Digital Marketing Marketing Operations

This one brings the two together.

£31,000-£36,000 DOE

Monday-Friday, 9am-5:30pm

Your Background / Skills: Marketing Coordination, Campaign Support, Event Management, Copywriting, Email Marketing, Digital Marketing, CMS, WordPress, Marketing Administration, Budget Tracking, Excel, Reporting.

At Tollring, we're passionate about helping businesses make smarter decisions through technology.

Our award-winning software helps organisations understand customer conversations, improve performance and unlock valuable insights from their communications.

With innovative solutions spanning call analytics, conversation intelligence, call recording and fraud protection, we're a growing technology business with ambitious plans and exciting new product launches ahead.

But what makes Tollring special is our people.

We're a collaborative team where ideas are welcomed, colleagues support one another and everyone has the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution.

Your Role in the Story

Working closely with our Marketing Communications Manager, Digital Marketer and Graphic Designer, you'll help keep a busy, varied marketing function running brilliantly.

One day you might be coordinating an industry event, the next preparing an email campaign, updating website content or pulling together performance reports for senior leadership.

You'll have plenty of guidance and support, but also the freedom to take ownership, solve problems and make things happen.

About You

You're a marketer at heart, but you're also someone who loves getting things organised and seeing a project through.

You enjoy writing, communicating and contributing creative ideas, while understanding that great marketing also depends on deadlines, budgets, accurate reporting and reliable execution.

You're confident working independently, happy to ask questions and willing to get stuck into whatever needs doing.

You'll bring:
- Around 2 years' experience in a marketing coordination, marketing executive or similar role, ideally within a busy, varied environment.
- Practical experience coordinating events, campaigns or marketing projects with competing deadlines.
- Strong written English, with the ability to draft clear, engaging marketing copy and proofread accurately.

- Experience liaising with suppliers, coordinating marketing materials or managing event logistics.
- A basic understanding of marketing principles and how campaigns engage different audiences.
- A proactive, adaptable approach and the confidence to work across different teams and priorities.

Even better if you have:
- Experience in B2 B technology, SaaS, software or telecoms.
- Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, Zoho CRM, Buffer or Mailchimp.
- Experience tracking marketing budgets, campaign performance or event-generated leads.
- An interest in using AI and emerging tools to improve marketing effectiveness.

You don't need to be an expert in every marketing discipline. What matters is that you've already developed a solid professional foundation, can manage your own workload and are genuinely excited to keep learning.

Why Join Tollring?

Because this isn't a role where you'll spend your career doing the same thing every day.

You'll gain exposure to campaigns, events, digital marketing, content, reporting and the commercial side of marketing, all while working alongside experienced colleagues who are happy to share their knowledge.

As Tollring continues to grow, there's real scope to develop your skills, take on more campaign responsibility and shape your future in marketing.

You'll also enjoy:
- Hybrid working with a supportive, collaborative team.
- Exposure to exciting technology, product launches and B2 B marketing.
- A varied role with genuine ownership and visibility across the business.
- Opportunities for training, learning and professional development.
- The chance to make a real impact within a growing, established technology company.

Ready to Make Things Happen?

If you're an organised, enthusiastic marketer who enjoys variety, loves getting the details right and wants to build a brilliant career in B2 B marketing, we'd love to hear from you.
